description: A schema 3 biological feature's stored source feature index and the index the promotion gives it (OV-274): Python promote_legacy_feature_catalog (gbdraw/web_support/feature_catalog.py, tests/test_web_feature_catalog.py) and JS migrateLegacyFeatureCatalog (services/feature-catalog.js, tests/web/feature-catalog.test.mjs) read these cases. A blank or whitespace-only alias is not supplied, as a blank text alias is, so the `<stableFeatureId>~<N>` suffix supplies the index; a supplied value is kept as stored, right or not, for validation to judge.

cases.name: whitespace-only legacy alias key takes the suffix
stored index is kept over the suffix
stored padded text index is kept as stored
stored invalid index is kept for validation
